_note: The 'how it works' film under the landing hero: four generated shots of five seconds, joined with zoom transitions and held one second on the last frame. Shots 1 and 4 are text-to-video and share the `woman` description below verbatim — that is the only way the same person appears at both ends. Shots 2 and 3 are image-to-video from a first frame this script draws: a 9:19.5 phone standing in the warm blur of her kedai, its screen filled edge to edge by stacking two of her own captures. Browser chrome is cropped off every layer and her login is painted out of the app header. Nothing on the glass is invented. Their prompts forbid redrawing the interface about as loudly as a prompt can; the model is under no obligation to listen, and the first frame is the only part guaranteed sharp.

1-idea.title: She has the idea

tail_push.note: The frame is already diving toward her phone when the transition starts, so the cut into shot 2 finishes a move this shot began.

1-idea.prompt: {woman}. She is standing in her own small, bright, lively kedai makan in the middle of the afternoon. Warm colourful daylight pours in through the shopfront behind her; red and yellow plastic chairs, a colourful drinks fridge and two or three customers eating at tables are all thrown far out of focus behind her. She holds her smartphone in one hand and looks down at it, thoughtful, her brow slightly furrowed — and then her face lights up, her eyes widening into a delighted smile, as if she has just had an idea. Her phone screen is dark and switched off; nothing on it is legible. Cinematic, photorealistic, vibrant saturated colour, warm afternoon light, shallow depth of field, slow steady push-in toward her.
